title: Jigarwala No. 1
desc: A doctor living abroad returns to India to sell his property, where he falls in love.

title: Khoonkhaar
desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

title: The Hero: Love Story of a Spy
desc: Arun Khanna, an Indian spy, collaborates with Reshma to stop a nuclear attack. However, Reshma's identity is compromised during her undercover mission in Pakistan.

title: Bangarraju
desc: A deceased couple returns to Earth to help their grandson, who lost his way in life after familial and personal problems start to haunt him.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: A man comes to America in order to find his brother who is wanted by the police. But his search forces him to get mixed up with a lady gangster that facilitates illegal underground fights.
